verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee offers pieces relevant to research agents — markdown output for LLM-friendly text (return_page_markdown), semantic AI extraction (ai_query/ai_extract_rules), and a Gemini API that returns citation objects — but there is no single documented 'research agent' preset that bundles these into one structured, citable output mode. missing for 10: a named/dedicated research-agent preset, explicit citation metadata tied to scraped page content (not just the Gemini wrapper), and independent evidence of this workflow being used by agents.
